title: Global board dogfood closeout
body: Implemented and verified browser dogfood coverage for the global board: linked global/alpha/beta fixture workspaces, routed global capture into a project, command-backed reserve drag, refused close drag with gate gaps and recovery commands, gate satisfaction followed by verified-to-closed drag, and cross-project portfolio unblock after daemon refresh. Updated getting-started docs with the global manager loop and fixed browser automation to use Playwright-managed Chromium/headless shell instead of system Chrome. Validation: focused browser/console suite passed and pnpm check passed. Git checkpoint: 711dc311.
